Clásico (estilo sueco): movimientos larg: Classic (Swedish style): long, gentle strokes over the whole back. The best one to start with.
Calienta el aceite en tus manos. Con las: Warm the oil in your hands. With flat hands, glide up the sides of the spine, open toward the shoulders, and come down the sides. Light pressure.
Mismo recorrido con un poco más de presi: Same path with a bit more pressure. Slow, steady rhythm. Never push on the spine.
Toma el músculo entre el pulgar y los de: Take the muscle between your thumb and fingers and knead it like bread dough, from the neck toward the shoulder. Ask if the pressure feels okay.
Pulgares a 2 o 3 cm de la columna. Círcu: Thumbs about an inch from the spine. Small circles, moving up little by little from the bottom to the neck. Repeat.
Con las yemas, recorre el borde interno: With your fingertips, trace the inner edge of the shoulder blade from bottom to top and out toward the shoulder.
Palmas o antebrazo, movimientos cortos d: Palms or forearm, short side-to-side strokes to build warmth. Avoid pressing on the kidney area.
Desde la columna hacia los costados, en: From the spine out to the sides, like a fan. Start low and work up to the shoulders.
Pasadas muy lentas y ligeras de arriba h: Very slow, light strokes from top to bottom. At the end, rest your hands still on the back for a few seconds.
Para quien pasa horas en la compu o anda: For anyone who spends hours at the computer or has tense shoulders. Focuses on the upper back.
Manos planas desde la mitad de la espald: Flat hands from the middle of the back upward, open over the shoulders, and return down the sides.
Pellizca suave el músculo entre el cuell: Gently pinch the muscle between the neck and shoulder and knead. Go from the neck outward and back.
Pulgares a los lados de la columna, just: Thumbs on either side of the spine, right where the neck begins. Small, slow circles. Don't press on the bone.
Con el pulgar, presiona cada punto unos: With your thumb, press each point for a few seconds, increase little by little, and release slowly. Ask from 1 to 10: don't go past 6.
Con las yemas, movimientos cortos de arr: With your fingertips, short up-and-down strokes between the spine and the shoulder blade.
Desde la base del cuello hacia la punta: From the base of the neck to the tip of the shoulders, as if brushing something off. Slowly.
Pasadas muy suaves del cuello hacia la m: Very gentle strokes from the neck to the middle of the back. Finish with your hands resting still on the shoulders.
Para cansancio en la cintura o la espald: For a tired waist or lower back. Warmth and gentle pressure on the lower back.
Manos planas en la espalda baja: sube po: Flat hands on the lower back: glide up the sides of the spine to the ribs and come down the sides.
Palmas planas, de lado a lado, rápido pe: Flat palms, side to side, quick but without pressing, until the skin feels warm.
Pulgares a los lados de la columna (nunc: Thumbs on either side of the spine (never on it). Slow circles from the bottom up toward the ribs.
Toma con las dos manos el costado de la: Take the side of the waist with both hands and knead. First one side, then the other.
Toma un pliegue de piel entre el pulgar: Take a fold of skin between your thumb and index finger and move it along as if rolling the skin, from the bottom up along the sides of the spine. Gently: if it hurts, take less skin.
Palmas a los lados de la columna. Inclin: Palms on either side of the spine. Lean your weight in little by little, hold 3 seconds, and release. No pressure on the kidneys.
Desde la columna hacia la cadera, en aba: From the spine out toward the hip, like a fan, from the bottom up to the waist.
Pasadas muy lentas y deja las palmas qui: Very slow strokes, then rest your warm palms still on the lower back for a few seconds.
Para nudos y tensión. Más presión y trab: For knots and tension. More pressure and point work, but always asking. If it hurts, ease up.
Long strokes with medium pressure. The muscle needs to be warm before you work on the knots.
Amasa trapecios y la zona de los omóplat: Knead the upper traps and the shoulder blade area, a bit firmer than in the relaxing massage. Ask: from 1 to 10, keep it between 5 and 7.
Con las yemas, frota de lado a lado a lo: With your fingertips, rub side to side along the muscles next to the spine. Where you feel a hard little lump, that's a knot.
Pulgar sobre el nudo: presiona poco a po: Thumb on the knot: press little by little, hold 10 to 20 seconds until you feel it release, and let go slowly. Never on the spine.
Con el talón de la mano, desliza muy len: With the heel of your hand, glide very slowly along the spine, from bottom to top. Like ironing the muscle.
Cierra la mano en puño suelto y desliza: Make a loose fist and glide with the flat part of your fingers (not the tips of the knuckles) over the muscles next to the spine, from bottom to top. Never on the spine itself.
Ahora suave otra vez: abanico desde la c: Now gentle again: fan out from the spine to the sides to calm the area you worked.
Pasadas lentas de arriba abajo y manos q: Slow strokes from top to bottom, and still hands at the end. Suggest drinking water.
Para despertar o antes de hacer ejercici: For waking up or before exercise. Fast rhythm, light taps, and friction.
Manos planas, recorridos largos y más rá: Flat hands, long strokes, faster than in the relaxing massage. Medium pressure.
Palmas de lado a lado, rápido, por toda: Palms side to side, fast, over the whole back (except on the spine). You should feel the warmth.
Con el canto de las manos relajadas (com: With the edges of your relaxed hands (like a karate chop), quick, light taps, alternating hands. Only on muscle: never on the spine or kidneys.
Mano abierta y relajada, con los dedos s: Hand open and relaxed, fingers loose and apart. Strike with the edge, letting the fingers knock together: it's lighter than with fingers closed. Only on muscle: never on the spine or kidneys.
Cierra las manos en puño suelto y golpea: Make loose fists and tap gently with the pinky side, alternating hands. Only on the upper back and shoulders; never on the spine or kidneys.
Ahueca las manos como un cuenco (dedos j: Cup your hands like a bowl (fingers together, palm hollowed) and tap gently, alternating hands. It should sound hollow, not like a slap. Only on the upper back; never on the spine or kidneys.
Amasa los trapecios con ritmo rápido, co: Knead the upper traps at a fast pace, as if squeezing a sponge.
Tres o cuatro pasadas firmes de abajo ha: Three or four firm strokes from bottom to top, and finish with a few pats on the shoulders.
Muy lento y ligero, con balanceo. Ideal: Very slow and light, with rocking. Ideal at night; it's fine if the person falls asleep.
Pon las manos quietas sobre la espalda,: Rest your hands still on the back, one high and one low. Breathe slowly together.
Deslizamientos larguísimos y casi sin pr: Very long strokes with almost no pressure. Count to 6 on each stroke.
Palmas en el costado lejano: empuja suav: Palms on the far side: push gently and let it come back, like rocking a cradle. Slow, steady rhythm.
Mano plana, círculos grandes y lentos so: Flat hand, big slow circles over the shoulder blades and lower back.
Solo con las yemas, como peinando, de ar: With just your fingertips, like combing, from top to bottom. Very light, barely touching.
Manos quietas otra vez y retíralas muy d: Still hands again, then lift them away very slowly. Don't talk; let them keep resting.
Movimientos largos y suaves de la muñeca: Long, gentle strokes from wrist to shoulder, always toward the heart. Good for starting out.
Calienta el aceite en tus manos. Con la: Warm the oil in your hands. With your palm, glide up from wrist to shoulder and return along the outside with almost no pressure. Go gently over the elbow.
El mismo recorrido con un poco más de pr: The same path with a bit more pressure going up. Pressure always goes toward the shoulder; coming down, just follow along.
Abraza el antebrazo con la mano en C y a: Wrap your hand around the forearm in a C shape and knead it like bread dough, from wrist to elbow.
Lo mismo arriba del codo: toma el múscul: The same above the elbow: take the muscle between your thumb and fingers, squeeze and release, moving up toward the shoulder.
Círculos pequeños con el pulgar sobre el: Small thumb circles on the muscle, going up one side and down the other. Not on the bone.
Con la palma, haz círculos lentos y ampl: With your palm, make slow, wide circles around the shoulder.
Para terminar, baja muy despacio con las: To finish, glide down very slowly with your fingertips, from shoulder to wrist, barely touching.
Para quien usa mucho el teclado, el celu: For heavy use of a keyboard, phone, or tools: loosens the forearm and wrist.
Con la palma, sube de la muñeca al codo: With your palm, glide up from wrist to elbow and return along one side. Several strokes until the skin feels warm.
Con el pulgar, ve y ven a lo largo del m: With your thumb, go back and forth along the muscle, first on one side of the forearm, then the other.
Presiona con el pulgar la parte carnosa: Press with your thumb on the fleshy part near the elbow: press slowly, hold, and release. It should be a pleasant ache; ask.
Con el puño suelto, desliza los nudillos: With a loose fist, glide your knuckles slowly from the wrist toward the elbow. Only on the muscle.
Círculos muy pequeños con el pulgar alre: Very small thumb circles around the wrist. Light pressure: there are tendons and bone here.
Abraza el antebrazo y amásalo despacio p: Wrap your hand around the forearm and knead it slowly to release what you worked.
Termina con pasadas largas y lentas de l: Finish with long, slow strokes from wrist to shoulder.
La parte de atrás de la pierna, con la p: The back of the leg, with the person face down. Long strokes toward the heart.
Con la palma, sube del tobillo al glúteo: With your palm, glide up from ankle to glute and return along the outside with no pressure. Behind the knee, just brush past without pressing.
Sube del tobillo hacia la rodilla con pr: Glide up from the ankle toward the knee with medium pressure and return along one side. Stop before the back of the knee.
Abraza la pantorrilla con la mano en C y: Wrap your hand around the calf in a C shape and knead, moving up little by little. Ask if the pressure feels okay.
Empieza arriba de la rodilla y sube hast: Start above the knee and glide up to the glute crease. Return along the outside with no pressure.
El muslo es un músculo grande: toma bast: The thigh is a big muscle: grab plenty with your whole hand, squeeze and release, moving up.
Círculos con el pulgar a los lados de la: Thumb circles on the sides of the calf, going up one side and down the other.
Con la mano ahuecada, da palmaditas rápi: With a cupped hand, give quick, light pats on the thigh. It should sound hollow, not hurt.
Baja muy despacio con las yemas, del glú: Glide down very slowly with your fingertips, from glute to ankle, barely touching.
Más firme, para después de caminar, corr: Firmer, for after walking, running, or standing a lot. Everything toward the heart.
Pasadas largas del tobillo al glúteo par: Long strokes from ankle to glute to warm up. Pressure going up; coming down, just follow along.
Con el pulgar, ve y ven a los lados del: With your thumb, go back and forth along the sides of the Achilles tendon, not on it. Light pressure.
Amasa la pantorrilla con más fuerza, des: Knead the calf more firmly, slowly. If the muscle tightens up or hurts, ease the pressure.
Presiona con el pulgar el centro de la p: Press with your thumb on the center of the calf: press slowly, hold, and release. A pleasant ache, no more.
Con el puño suelto, desliza los nudillos: With a loose fist, glide your knuckles slowly from above the knee up to the glute.
Toma el músculo del muslo con toda la ma: Take the thigh muscle with your whole hand, squeeze and release. Move up little by little.
Con el canto de la mano, golpecitos rápi: With the edge of your hand, quick, loose taps on the thigh. Keep your wrist loose.
Pasadas largas y lentas hacia el glúteo,: Long, slow strokes toward the glute, as if pushing the tiredness upward.
Palma, dedos y muñeca. Corto y muy agrad: Palm, fingers, and wrist. Short and very pleasant; goes well after the arm.
Sostén su mano con una de las tuyas. Con: Hold their hand with one of yours. With your other palm, glide from the wrist to the fingertips.
Con el pulgar, deslízate del centro de l: With your thumb, glide from the center of the palm out to the edges, as if ironing it open.
Círculos pequeños con el pulgar por toda: Small thumb circles all over the palm. It can take good pressure here.
El cojín de la base del pulgar es el que: The pad at the base of the thumb works the hardest: slow, deep circles.
Toma cada dedo entre tu pulgar y tu índi: Take each finger between your thumb and index finger and glide from base to tip, with a gentle little tug at the end.
Círculos muy pequeños y ligeros alrededo: Very small, light circles around the wrist.
Termina envolviendo su mano entre las tu: Finish by wrapping their hand in yours and gliding slowly until the fingers slip free.
Más presión en la palma y en la base del: More pressure on the palm and the base of the thumb. For hands that type, carry, or grip all day.
Varias pasadas con la palma, de la muñec: Several palm strokes, from wrist to fingers, to warm up the hand.
Con el pulgar, ve y ven a lo largo de la: With your thumb, go back and forth along the palm in three lanes: the pinky side, the center, and next to the thumb.
Presiona con el pulgar: aprieta despacio: Press with your thumb: press slowly, hold a few seconds, and release. Cover the center and the base of the fingers.
Tres puntos en el cojín de la base del p: Three points on the pad at the base of the thumb. It's often tender: build pressure little by little.
Círculos chiquitos sobre cada articulaci: Tiny circles over each finger joint, without forcing them.
Desliza cada dedo de la base a la punta: Glide each finger from base to tip between your thumb and index finger. Don't crack it.
Pasadas lentas de la muñeca a la punta d: Slow strokes from the wrist to the fingertips to finish.
La planta del pie, del talón a los dedos: The sole of the foot, from heel to toes. Firm, confident pressure: a light touch tickles.
Sostén el pie con una mano. Con la otra: Hold the foot with one hand. With your other palm, glide from heel to toes with firm pressure so it doesn't tickle.
Con el pulgar, sube del talón a los dedo: With your thumb, glide from heel to toes in three lanes: the outer edge, the center, and the inner edge.
El talón tiene la piel gruesa: círculos: The heel has thick skin: thumb circles with good pressure.
Ve y ven con el pulgar a lo largo del ar: Go back and forth with your thumb along the arch. If it hurts or cramps, ease the pressure.
Círculos con el pulgar en el cojín de de: Thumb circles on the pad below the toes, from one side to the other.
Toma cada dedo entre tu pulgar y tu índi: Take each toe between your thumb and index finger, turn it a little, and glide toward the tip with a gentle little tug.
Termina con pasadas lentas y firmes del: Finish with slow, firm strokes from heel to toes.
Presiones sostenidas con el pulgar por t: Sustained thumb pressure all over the sole. Really rests the feet after a day of standing.
Varias pasadas firmes con la palma, del: Several firm palm strokes, from heel to toes, until the foot feels warm.
Presiona con el pulgar: aprieta despacio: Press with your thumb: press slowly, hold, and release. Three points on the heel.
Sube por un lado del arco y baja por el: Go up one side of the arch and down the other, point by point. It's more sensitive here: medium pressure.
Con el puño suelto, desliza los nudillos: With a loose fist, glide your knuckles slowly from the heel toward the ball of the foot.
Un punto debajo de cada dedo, en el cojí: One point under each toe, on the pad of the ball of the foot.
Aprieta suave cada dedo entre tu pulgar: Gently squeeze each toe between your thumb and index finger and glide toward the tip.
Repasa toda la planta con el pulgar, del: Go over the whole sole with your thumb, from heel to toes, in three lanes.
Pasadas lentas y firmes para terminar. D: Slow, firm strokes to finish. Rest your hand still on the foot for a few seconds before letting go.
Bolitas amarillas: hombros, costillas y: Yellow dots: shoulders, ribs, and glutes
Los glúteos marcan hasta dónde llega el: The glutes mark how far the massage goes.
Bolitas amarillas: muñeca, codo y hombro: Yellow dots: wrist, elbow, and shoulder
The drawing runs from wrist to shoulder.
Bolitas amarillas: tobillo, rodilla y gl: Yellow dots: ankle, knee, and glute
La persona boca abajo. El dibujo va del: Person face down. The drawing runs from ankle to glute.
Bolitas amarillas: muñeca, base de los d: Yellow dots: wrist, base of the fingers, and fingertips
Si el pulgar queda del otro lado, toca V: If the thumb ends up on the other side, tap Flip.
Bolitas amarillas: talón, arco y dedos: Yellow dots: heel, arch, and toes
Si el dedo gordo queda del otro lado, to: If the big toe ends up on the other side, tap Flip.
Bolitas amarillas: media espalda, hombro: Yellow dots: mid back, shoulders, and nape
La persona sentada, tú de pie detrás. El: The person sits, you stand behind. The drawing stands upright on their back.
La persona sentada, con la espalda derec: The person sits with a straight back. Loosens shoulders, neck and upper back. No oil, over clothes.
Párate detrás. Apoya las palmas sobre lo: Stand behind. Rest your palms on the shoulders and ask for three deep breaths. Don't squeeze yet.
Con las palmas, sube por los lados de la: With your palms, go up along the sides of the spine, open toward the shoulders and come down the outside. No rush.
Toma el músculo de encima del hombro ent: Take the muscle on top of the shoulder between thumb and fingers, squeeze and release, from the neck outward. Ask if the pressure feels good.
Pulgares a dos dedos de la columna. Círc: Thumbs two finger-widths from the spine. Small circles, moving up little by little to shoulder height. Never on the bone.
Con las yemas, recorre el borde interno: With your fingertips, trace the inner edge of the shoulder blade from bottom to top.
Abraza la nuca con una mano: el pulgar d: Cup the nape with one hand: thumb on one side, fingers on the other. Squeeze gently and release, moving up toward the head. Support the forehead with your other hand.
Con los pulgares, presiona justo debajo: With your thumbs, press just under the bone of the head, at the sides of the neck. Hold five seconds and release. Very gentle.
Para terminar, baja despacio con las pal: To finish, glide slowly with your palms from the shoulders down to mid back, with almost no pressure.
Unos minutos para quien pasa horas frent: A few minutes for someone who spends hours at a computer: shoulders, neck and upper back, right in their chair.
Con las manos ahuecadas, da golpecitos s: With cupped hands, tap the shoulders lightly and quickly, alternating hands. Stay away from the neck and the spine.
Aprieta el músculo del hombro, sostén do: Squeeze the shoulder muscle, hold two seconds and release. Work from the neck outward.
Con las yemas, frota corto y rápido entr: With your fingertips, rub short and fast between the spine and the shoulder blade, from the inside out, to warm it up.
Con los pulgares, presiona el punto más: With your thumbs, press the tightest spot on top of the shoulder. Press slowly, hold and release. It should be a good kind of ache; ask.
Abraza la nuca con una mano y amasa suav: Cup the nape with one hand and knead gently upward. Support the forehead with your other hand.
Pasadas largas y lentas de los hombros h: Long, slow strokes from the shoulders downward to finish.
Movimientos suaves de rodilla y tobillo,: Gentle knee and ankle movements, with the person face down. The screen above shows how the leg moves.
Unas pasadas largas del tobillo al glúte: A few long strokes from ankle to glute, to signal that you are about to move the leg.
Toma el tobillo con una mano y apoya la: Hold the ankle with one hand and rest the other on the upper thigh. Bring the heel toward the glute, slowly, as far as it goes without pain, and return. Watch the screen.
Con la rodilla doblada, sostén el tobill: With the knee bent, hold the ankle and rock the leg from side to side, loose, like a pendulum.
Con la rodilla doblada, sostén la pierna: With the knee bent, hold the leg above the ankle and with your other hand turn the foot in slow circles, one way and then the other.
Baja la pierna con cuidado y termina con: Lower the leg carefully and finish with long, slow strokes.
Estiramientos suaves de cuello y hombro,: Gentle neck and shoulder stretches, seated. The screen above shows the movement. Never force the neck.
Apoya una mano en el hombro para que no: Rest one hand on the shoulder so it stays down. With the other, tilt the head toward the opposite side, very slowly. Hold five seconds, return and switch sides.
Apoya una mano sobre el hombro. Con la o: Rest one hand on the shoulder. With the other, take the arm by the wrist and swing it forward and back, loose, like a pendulum. Then the other arm.
Con la rodilla doblada, rodea el tobillo: With the knee bent, wrap your open hand around the ankle and slowly turn the leg in circles, from one side to the other. Your other hand rests on the thigh.
